migrationStrategy: Compatibility-first; legacy localStorage names and record shape are retained. No forced IndexedDB conversion and no destructive migration are performed in this foundation build.
legacyKeyMigrationSupport: Existing V18.7 migration module and its source aliases remain in place. No legacy key is explicitly deleted by V19 modules.
indexedDbMigration: Not performed. Existing app state remains in the legacy stores to avoid an untested schema conversion.
backupRecommendation: Export a full application backup before updating the installed PWA. Test the update against a copied browser profile before relying on it for the only copy of study progress.
notes: V19 keeps the old localStorage storage keys and existing app-state format; it does not migrate user data to IndexedDB in this release.
Data continuity is expected when the new package is served from the same origin and scope, but that behavior has not been verified against a real browser profile in this build environment.
Do not delete the old app/browser data when upgrading. Keep an exported backup until the new version has been manually verified.
